title: Revision
description: Per-revision metadata. Lives at examples/<project>/revisions/<id>/revision.json. Mirrors the TemplateProject ↔ Revision contract used by tools/revision-manager and consumed by tools/preview-renderer, tools/visual-diff, and the agent prompts.

schemaVersion.description: On-disk artifact contract version. Absent on pre-versioning revisions (treated as 1). Stamped by tools/revision-manager on every write.

parentRevisionId.description: Parent revision the diff and rollback model are computed against; null for the first revision in a chain.

status.description: Revision lifecycle state. Owned by tools/revision-manager — agents must never mutate this directly.

userRequest.description: Verbatim user gesture that opened this revision (single-line summary).

scope.description: Optional scope marker the orchestrator writes per prompts/orchestrator-agent.md § Revision scope. This enum fixes the vocabulary only: which stages each scope runs, and which gate it ends on, is declared once in config/pipeline.json and read through scripts/lib/pipeline-config.mjs. The inferred scope "new" is deliberately absent — it applies to a first revision, which has no parent to diff against, and is never written into revision.json. scripts/test/pipeline-config.test.mjs asserts that this enum and the config agree.

targetGraphComposeVersion.description: GraphCompose version pin used to compile and render this revision.

skillPack.description: Repo-relative path to the skill pack folder used by the agents.

changedComponents.description: Optional list of named private render methods whose output this revision modified — feeds the selective rollback model.

reviewVerdict.description: Outcome of the last review pass over this revision, copied from visual-review.json. Deliberately separate from `status`: the revision stays DRAFT until a human approves it, so READY_FOR_APPROVAL records that the loop has stopped and is waiting, not that anything was approved.

iteration.description: 1-based position of this revision inside one autonomous fix loop (fix → build → render → review → fix). Absent on revisions a human opened directly. Bounded by limits.maxIterations in config/pipeline.json.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this revision was opened.

artifacts.description: Artifact label → filename map (relative to the revision folder). Labels are well-known but the schema is open so the orchestrator can add new artifact types.

pendingArtifacts.description: Artifact filenames the revision declares but has not yet produced. The repository-contract gate tolerates a missing artifact only when it is listed here.

templateDisplayName.description: Optional human-readable name the template publisher uses. Present once the revision becomes the source of a published template under templates/.

approvedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp Revision Manager writes when status flips to APPROVED.

supersededAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp Revision Manager writes when status flips to SUPERSEDED.

supersededBy.description: ID of the revision that superseded this one.

stage.description: Pipeline stage that produced the failure. "unspecified" is written when a revision is failed without naming a stage — honest about the gap rather than guessing one.

category.description: Why the run stopped, as opposed to `stage`, which records where. The vocabulary is shared with config/pipeline.json → failureCategories.

message.description: Verbatim error message from the failing stage.

currentUsableDraft.description: ID of the most recent draft revision that still renders, when applicable.

failure.description: Present when status is FAILED. Records the failing stage and verbatim error so the orchestrator can route the next attempt.

failureCategory.description: Why an attempt stopped. Kept in $defs so every contract that has to report a stop reason — the failure record here, visual-review.schema.json, and the blocked-run record a later phase adds — shares one vocabulary with config/pipeline.json → failureCategories.

allOf.description: Scope-conditional artifact requirements. Fires only when `scope` is present, so existing scope-less revisions stay valid.
data-only inherits architecturePlan / visualAnalysis / assetsManifest from the parent revision; it does NOT produce its own copies.
asset-only re-runs the resolver but inherits everything else from the parent.
FAILED revisions must carry the failure record, regardless of scope.
SUPERSEDED revisions must record what superseded them.
